turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
“Okay… I don’t feel safe—someone’s watching me. I can’t answer questions, but I’m very out of it and my body feels out of control.”
What substance or medication have you taken today or in the last 24 hours—including alcohol, cannabis, stimulants, opioids, benzos, psychedelics, or any new prescription/OTC meds?
“I don’t know—things get blurry, but I think I used drugs again. I can’t focus enough to list what, and I’m scared someone’s monitoring me.”
Are you having any of these right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, severe headache, seizure-like shaking, or thoughts of hurting yourself or anyone else?

“I don’t have chest pain or trouble breathing, and I’m not trying to hurt anyone—but I feel very shaky and stiff, and I’m too out of it to answer more. I feel like my body isn’t regulating right, and I’m extremely paranoid right now.”
